newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-AMOUNT OF INJURY TIME TO BE ANNOUNCED IN PORTUGAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMOUNT OF INJURY TIME TO BE ANNOUNCED IN PORTUGAL.

text.p: A referee will inform spectators how much injury time is to be played in Portuguese professional soccer matches, the league said on Thursday.
"The objective is to avoid uncertainties and speculation about the end of each game," a statement said.
A referee will use the substitute card numbers to inform spectators how much time remains when the whistle blows after 90 minutes. The new rule will take effect immediately.
